upload.title: Data Upload
upload.subtitle: Import CP data files from the wafer fab

steps.label: Select Vendor
steps.desc: Choose the corresponding vendor (JJW, XRW) in the Format Configuration panel. The system will use the matching parse template — ensure the selection matches the file source.

steps.label: Upload File
steps.desc: Drag and drop an .xlsx file onto the upload area, or click Browse Files to select manually. The system will automatically parse and display a preview.

steps.label: Verify Preview
steps.desc: The preview panel shows wafer count, data rows, format code, product ID, and lot ID. Confirm the information is correct before proceeding.

steps.label: Confirm & Import
steps.desc: Click Confirm & Import to write the data to the database. A success banner will display the lot code, wafer count, and total rows.

notes: Only .xlsx format is supported. For old .xls files, re-save as .xlsx in Excel first.
The selected vendor must match the actual file format — a mismatch will be rejected with an error.
If the system cannot auto-detect the format, manually select a vendor and retry.

review.title: CP Review
review.subtitle: View yield and electrical compliance per wafer

steps.label: Select Lot
steps.desc: Choose the lot to review from the dropdown at the top. The list shows vendor, product, and lot code.

steps.label: Run Review
steps.desc: Click Run Review. The system calculates Q1 yield for each electrical parameter on every wafer using the CP Spec limits, then saves the results.

steps.label: View Summary
steps.desc: The table shows BIN1 yield, Q1/Q2 compliance, and PASS / WARN / FAIL status for each wafer.

steps.label: View Details
steps.desc: Click any wafer row to open the detail page — showing average, stdev, Q1 yield, and failure distribution per parameter.

notes: Q1 compliance threshold: all wafers must have yield ≥ 95%. Q2 requires additional review rules to be configured.
Always click Run Review after uploading. Re-run if spec limits are changed to refresh results.

steps.label: Select Lot
steps.desc: Choose the lot from the dropdown. The system loads all electrical parameter specs for that lot.

steps.label: Select Parameters
steps.desc: Check the parameters you want to compare — multiple selections are supported.

steps.label: View Results
steps.desc: The view shows spec limits (upper/lower), measured averages, and deviation from spec center. Out-of-spec values are highlighted in red.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Search historical lot records by criteria

steps.label: Set Filters
steps.desc: Filter by vendor, product, lot code, or date range.

steps.label: View Results
steps.desc: The list shows matching lots with vendor, product, wafer count, yield, and review status.

steps.label: Open Review
steps.desc: Click any lot row to navigate to the CP Review page for that lot.

analytics.title: Analytics & AI
analytics.subtitle: Yield trends, correlation matrix, and AI summaries

steps.label: Yield Trend
steps.desc: A line chart displays BIN1 yield trends across recent lots per vendor, making it easy to spot declining or improving yield.

steps.label: Anomaly Detection
steps.desc: Lots with yield below the target threshold are flagged. The table shows the reason and deviation value for each anomaly.

steps.label: Correlation Matrix
steps.desc: A heatmap shows correlation coefficients between electrical parameters. High-correlation pairs are highlighted to help identify common-cause failures.

steps.label: AI Summary
steps.desc: Select a lot and click Generate Summary. The AI analyzes yield, anomalies, and parameter patterns to produce a written summary report.

notes: AI summaries require a valid backend API key. Contact your system administrator if errors occur.

steps.label: Profile
steps.desc: Displays your account information — name, employee ID, department, and email. This is read-only.

steps.label: Theme
steps.desc: Switch between Light, Dark, or System theme. Changes take effect immediately.

steps.label: Language
steps.desc: Switch the interface language between 简体中文, 繁體中文, or English. The entire UI updates instantly.
